title: VirtualList
description: Renders long lists efficiently by only mounting the rows that are visible in the scroll container.

support.notes: Fixed-height native ScrollView windowing with optional first-row measurement, item padding, overscan, compact short lists, native item click events, optional 16 ms scroll batching, pixel loading thresholds and Promise load-more mutual exclusion. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Both React and this renderer use one fixed row height. Native scheduling uses a 16 ms timer instead of browser requestAnimationFrame/requestIdleCallback; browser ref targets are not reproduced. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: VirtualList
translationResources.description: Renders long lists efficiently by only mounting the rows that are visible in the scroll container.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: 10,000 rows with a fixed itemHeight; only the visible rows (plus overscan) are in the DOM.

auto-height.title: Measured row height
auto-height.description: Omit itemHeight to measure it from the first rendered item; itemPadding is added around each row.

infinite-scroll.title: Infinite scroll
infinite-scroll.description: onLoadMore is called near the bottom of the list; show a loading indicator while it resolves.

high-performance.title: High performance mode
high-performance.description: highPerformance batches scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame and requestIdleCallback, here with 100,000 rows.

clickable-rows.title: Clickable rows and native attributes
clickable-rows.description: onItemClick makes the rows clickable (pointer cursor, focusable, activated with Enter / Space); without it rows keep the default cursor. Native attributes such as id, data-* and aria-* are forwarded to the root.

VirtualListProps.itemHeight: Fixed row height in pixels; measured from the first item when omitted
VirtualListProps.itemPadding: Padding of each row in pixels
VirtualListProps.overscan: Number of rows rendered above and below the visible area
VirtualListProps.maxHeight: Maximum height of the scroll container in pixels
VirtualListProps.renderItem: Renders the content of one row
VirtualListProps.style: Inline styles of the scroll container
VirtualListProps.onLoadMore: Called when scrolling near the bottom; return a promise that resolves once new items are loaded (no new call happens until it settles)
VirtualListProps.loadMoreThreshold: Distance from the bottom (px) at which onLoadMore is triggered
VirtualListProps.highPerformance: Batches scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame and requestIdleCallback
VirtualListProps.loading: Shows a loading indicator at the bottom of the list
VirtualListProps.ref: Ref to the root (scroll container) <div> element
VirtualListProps.onItemClick: Called when a row is clicked, or activated with Enter / Space while the row itself has focus. Makes the rows clickable: focusable and shown with a pointer cursor

cssVars.--virtual-list-loading-padding: Padding of the loading indicator row

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Set the items and renderItem properties from JavaScript: only the rows in view are rendered, even with 10,000 items. Name the list with aria-label.

clickable-rows.title: Clickable rows
clickable-rows.description: clickable makes rows focusable and fires minerva-item-click on click, Enter or Space. scrollToIndex() scrolls programmatically.

infinite-scroll.title: Infinite scroll
infinite-scroll.description: minerva-load-more fires near the bottom (load-more-threshold); set loading while the next page is fetched.

props.clickable: Makes rows focusable and clickable (pointer cursor, Enter / Space) and fires minerva-item-click.
props.scrollContainer: The scroll container element (read-only), e.g. to scroll programmatically.

events.minerva-item-click: A clickable row was clicked or activated with Enter / Space (detail: { item, index }).
events.minerva-load-more: The list was scrolled within load-more-threshold pixels of the bottom.

cssVars.--progress-bar-height: Thickness of the loading indicator bar.
cssVars.--progress-track-color: Track color of the loading indicator.
cssVars.--progress-radius: Corner radius of the loading indicator track.
cssVars.--progress-size: Size of the round loading indicator.

methods.scrollToIndex: Scrolls so that the row at index is at the top of the list.
